reading.focus: Results on obstacle density, Table 1, methods, complete byline/affiliations, acknowledgements, and limits of the geometric/control model
visual_checks: Table 1, PDF p4, original rendered page: all six condition rows, mean/SD, N flights and n bees checked.
reading.statistical_unit: Each flight is averaged first; published means and SD are across N flights, not across n unique bees. Repeated flights from the same bee are present; unique bees across conditions cannot be summed. Table 1 reports post-hoc Tukey HSD, not a mixed-effects reanalysis.
reading.recording: Two high-speed cameras at 200 fps; reconstructed 3D trajectories. This is externally measured metric motion, not metric scale recovered by an insect from monocular optic flow.
reading.conditions: 3 m corridor, 0.6 m width and 0.6 m high walls; obstacle rows 0.1 m from centre, plates 0.03 x 0.004 x 0.6 m. Red/white dead-leaves texture; six obstacle arrangements including narrowed 0.4 m continuous-wall control.
reading.new_chinese_summary: 在同一受控走廊的六种障碍布局下，熊蜂的逐次飞行平均前向速度呈不同分布。空走廊为1.337±0.235 m/s（46次飞行、26只蜂）；双侧障碍覆盖率16%和33%时分别为1.013±0.249和0.836±0.181 m/s（49/25、32/19）。这些实测数据可约束环境依赖的飞行速度先验，但不是对自然场景总体距离分布、旋转—平移联合分布或动物绝对尺度估计的验证。
